name: Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd
summary: Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. engages in the real estate and renewable green energy business in Israel and Germany. The company operates real estate properties, including commercial centers and hotels. The company is also involved in the development, construction, acquisition, and holding of photovoltaic power generation systems. In addition, It operates gas stations and convenience stores and retail; and supplies fuels. The company was formerly known as S.R. Overseas Investments Ltd. and changed its name to Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. in January 2012. Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Yakum, Israel.
